dedupe_keys.name: transport for london road network tlrn

description: TfL publishes line geometry for the red routes it manages and maintains. The schema includes road labels, descriptive terms, road nature, TOID identifiers and edit dates. The source directs users to LAST_EDIT_DATE for currency. Feature-service and WFS items describe the same road-network resource. The separate highway-authority polygon gives administrative extent; this line layer does not by itself establish lane-level topology or live conditions. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
